This '''apartment''' was the residence of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Christo/Legends|Christo]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It had a large [[Aquarium/Legends|aquarium]], and offered a good view of the Coruscant skyline. [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] spoke to Christo here about the [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|bill]] to fund five million [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].
